title: Sharp Minimax Regret for Infinite-Memory Logistic Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.26515v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study online prediction for a specific finite-alphabet, exogenously driven source with infinite input memory. Independent Rademacher inputs $(U_t)$ are observed sequentially, and the next binary mark has logit $\sum_{j=1}^{t}\theta_jU_{t+1-j}$, where $\abs{\theta_j}\leq r_j$ and $\sum_jr_j\leq B$. Regret is expected cumulative excess log loss. Lag $j$ can affect prediction by scale $r_j$ and enters only $n_{T,j}=T-j+1$ prediction rounds, leading to the lag-resolved spectrum $\Gamma_T(r)=\sum_{j=1}^{T}\log\!\left(1+n_{T,j}r_j^2\right)$. For every summable envelope, a localized Bayesian mixture proves $\cR_T(r)\leq C\Gamma_T(r)$. For exponential and polynomial envelopes, under the stated finite-sample dimension condition, a Toeplitz-design converse proves $\cR_T(r)\geq c\Gamma_T(r)$, with constants allowed to depend on the fixed decay parameters and the logit bound. Thus $\Gamma_T(r)$ is the minimax cumulative-regret scale for this so

translated_title: 无限记忆逻辑预测的尖锐极小极大遗憾
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26515v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们研究了一个具有无限输入记忆的特定有限字母表、外生驱动源的在线预测问题。独立Rademacher输入$(U_t)$被顺序观测，下一个二元标记的对数几率（logit）为$\sum_{j=1}^{t}\theta_jU_{t+1-j}$，其中$\abs{\theta_j}\leq r_j$且$\sum_jr_j\leq B$。遗憾定义为期望累积超额对数损失。滞后$j$可以通过尺度$r_j$影响预测，并且仅在$n_{T,j}=T-j+1$个预测轮次中起作用，这导致了滞后分辨谱$\Gamma_T(r)=\sum_{j=1}^{T}\log\!\left(1+n_{T,j}r_j^2\right)$。对于每个可求和包络，局部贝叶斯混合证明了$\cR_T(r)\leq C\Gamma_T(r)$。对于指数和多项式包络，在所述有限样本维度条件下，Toeplitz设计逆命题证明了$\cR_T(r)\geq c\Gamma_T(r)$，其中常数允许依赖于固定衰减参数和对数几率界。因此，$\Gamma_T(r)$是此问题的极小极大累积遗憾尺度。
tldr: 本文为无限记忆逻辑预测问题建立了尖锐的极小极大遗憾界，证明了滞后分辨谱$\Gamma_T(r)$是精确的累积遗憾尺度，并通过局部贝叶斯混合和Toeplitz设计分别给出了匹配的上界和下界。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes sharp minimax regret bounds for infinite-memory logistic prediction, showing that the lag-resolved spectrum $\Gamma_T(r)$ is the exact cumulative regret scale, with matching upper and lower bounds via localized Bayesian mixtures and Toeplitz designs.
